definitions.site: forward-hook output of get_layer_module(model, 26) = transformer block index 25 (0-based), hidden state 26
definitions.positions: aligned session positions (SES and SESCOUNT classes); O source and R destination from H6's key alignment
definitions.adapted_state: adapter enabled; bf16 residual output of that block
definitions.base_state: same input with model.disable_adapter(); bf16 residual output of that block
definitions.path_A: delta = (adapted - base) computed in bf16, then .float(); used by H6 to build intended codes and the edit
definitions.path_B: delta = adapted.float() - base.float(); used by H6's post-patch verification
definitions.normalization: u = (delta - x_mean) / x_std; pre = u @ W_enc^T + b_enc; ReLU; TopK(k); float32
definitions.edit: e = ((z_O,S - z_R,S) @ D_S^T) * x_std from path-A codes; applied with put(add=True): hs + e.to(bf16) in bf16
definitions.patched_state: block output captured after the hook (bf16)
definitions.batches: first 4 receivers in batches of 2, then batches of 6, as in H6
